label: Numeric age
text: EA.O.A3.3 Numeric age. The decay law N = N₀e^(−λt) is owned by PH (uses PH nuclear cell). The dating claim is owned here. It holds when the system closed at a stated time, with known initial daughter and no later gain or loss. Carbon-14 serves late-Quaternary organic matter, to about 50,000 years. U–Pb and other systems serve deep time. Luminescence, dendrochronology and varves are other numeric methods.

warrant.standard: Stated decay constant, closure assumption and uncertainty
